facts.note: The refusal to show the watch is placed at nine, when Monnier made everyone show watches, not 'at dinner' as the sheet has it. The brandy, the temple striking ten heard from the dining room, and not looking at the watch are all present.
Goes out into the street at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch and stays under the front windows of the house.
Piano starts in the salon as he lights his cigar at twenty-nine minutes past ten by his watch, and stops at eighteen minutes to eleven by his watch.
At twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch he hears faint quick bells from the master's window upstairs, with the piano playing throughout.
Comes back in at fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch; the hall clock has just struck eleven and its face shows two minutes past eleven; then goes up to Félix in the library.

added.quote: At nine Monnier had made us all show our watches, as he does every year.
added.why: Places a watch-showing event at nine o'clock, before the temple strikes ten. The detective learns the evening had a fixed nine o'clock moment, which the sheet does not give.
